title: Vibecoder Quickstart
description: For experienced developers who want the lay of the land in under 5 minutes. 7 steps, fast path only.

steps.title: The full source tree
steps.description:
Welcome. Everything editable is under `ClientApp/src/` (TS/TSX) and `ClientApp/src/styles/` (SCSS). Everything else is generated or vendor — don't touch it.

This file is the entry point. Three things happen before React renders:
1. MSAL async init (Azure AD B2C)
2. TrustedTypes/DOMPurify CSP policy
3. React 18 `createRoot` render inside `MsalProvider → AccountProvider → StrictMode → RouterProvider`

Note the top-level `await` on line 13 — requires bundler support.

steps.title: All 25+ routes
steps.description:
Every route is here. Three patterns:
- `<Layout>` — public pages (help, sign-out-helper)
- `<AuthenticatedElement>` — protected pages (dashboard, services)
- `<AuthenticatedElement displayHeaderAndFooter={false}>` — wizard flows that manage their own chrome (create-account, RFQ, accept-quote)

The wildcard `path='*'` at line 302 catches everything else → 404.

steps.title: Auth guard
steps.description:
`AuthenticatedElement` = PreConditions gate + MSAL redirect + ErrorBoundary, all in one.

For every protected route: if not authed → B2C redirect. If route errors → `RedirectToHome` (404 vs server-error). If uncaught exception → `ErrorBoundary` reports to App Insights and shows `<ErrorDisplay>`.

Pass `displayHeaderAndFooter={false}` for wizard flows.

steps.title: Dashboard — the main event
steps.description:
The Dashboard is the primary authenticated view — 776 lines. It manages:
- Three tabs: Drafts / Requests / Instruments (each calls a different API endpoint)
- Search + filter + sort (via `SearchFilter` + `initialFilters` state)
- Pagination (10 items per page)
- Branch selector modal + RFQ delete modal
- Session storage workaround for accepted-quote status (line 212 — known API lag bug)
- Google Analytics event tracking on every interaction

Modifying this file? Read the whole thing first — there are inter-dependent `useEffect` chains.

steps.title: Multi-step forms — WizardForm
steps.description:
All multi-step data-entry flows (create account, RFQ, accept quote) run through `WizardForm`.

It's a compound component: `<WizardForm>` reads its `<WizardStep>` children and converts each to a `<Route>`. Navigation is done by React Router — going to the next step is just a route push.

Line 27: validates children are `WizardStep` using `React.Children.forEach` — throws if not. Line 95: wildcard route redirects any unknown path to the last step.

steps.title: Runtime config — the one rule
steps.description:
Config is injected by the server into `window.*` before the bundle loads.

**The rule**: Always use `env.*` from this file. Never use `process.env.*` — it's `undefined` in the browser.

```ts
import { env } from '../env';
env.REACT_APP_B2C_CLIENTID  // ✓
process.env.REACT_APP_B2C_CLIENTID  // ✗ undefined
```

All 11 config vars are defined here: B2C client ID, authority, scopes, redirect URIs, App Insights connection string, GA tracking ID.

**Gotcha**: The `(<any>window)` cast has been replaced with typed `globalThis` access via `declare global`. A startup guard now calls `console.error` for missing vars. The fundamental rule remains: use `env.*`, never `process.env.*`.

steps.title: You've got the vibe
steps.description:
In 6 steps you've seen:
- Bootstrap sequence + provider hierarchy
- Full route tree + auth guard pattern
- Dashboard architecture (tabs, pagination, session workarounds)
- WizardForm compound component
- The env config rule

**Two things to know before you write code:**
1. Any Yup schema file that uses custom validators (`.phone()`, `.postcode()`, `.allowedFormat()`, etc.) **must** have: `import '../../validationSchemas/yupExtensions';` — or you get a silent runtime failure.
2. Access user state via `useAccountState()` (read) and `useAccountDispatch()` (mutations) from `authentication/hooks.tsx`. For modal visibility, use `useModalState()` / `useModalDispatch()` from `components/modals/ModalContext`. Never import contexts directly.

**Deeper dives:**
- **New Joiner Onboarding** — full 14-step walkthrough
- **WizardForm Deep Dive** — if you're touching a multi-step flow
- **React 19 Migration Prep** — if you're scoping the upgrade
